paper_id: <short identifier for this wjx paper, e.g. mBfE06C>
_comment_bank: Identifies which question bank this paper was imported from. wjx_exam_assist verifies the bank file's sha256 matches before allowing --static-fallback-on-risk. Compute via: sha256sum data/processed/question_bank_merged.json
_comment_static_answers: Path AND sha256 of the per-import answers JSON. Both --answers (if passed) and the manifest-adopted file are hashed at startup; mismatch refuses static fallback. This closes the 'same-bank only' trust boundary.
_comment_overrides: List of human-verified per-question truths that take precedence over lookup, EVEN over hard-block notes like negation_mismatch. Use only after dry-run confirms the wjx backend's correct answer differs from what the bank parser produced. If an override exists but cannot be mapped to the current page (option_count mismatch, label drift, etc.), the question is forced into HIGHLIGHT-ONLY — automation will NOT silently fall back to lookup/static.
